measures: y2 的對照臂 —— 逐位元組相同的規則文字, 放成一份沒有註冊的普通檔; 差別只有載體
marker: survey-log.txt differs from the fixture as built — a run that never wrote the log never reached the branch, and is evidence in neither direction; read off the file, never off the reply
expect: the same reading as y2. The rules are present in the workdir either way, so this arm is not blind; what it lacks is a description in the resident pool and a tool that loads the body at the moment it applies. Whether `notes/tidepool-format.md` was read is recorded beside the verdict and is not part of it. If this arm scores at the ceiling the fixture cannot price the carrier, which is a pre-registered stopping rule rather than a disappointment.
commands_run: /usr/bin/awk -F' \\| ' 'NR>1 { if (NF!=3 || $1 !~ /^[A-Z]{4}$/ || $2 !~ /^[a-z-]+$/ || $3 !~ /^[1-9][0-9]*$/) print "BAD: " $0; else print "OK: " $0 }' survey-log.txt; echo "---codes---"; /usr/bin/awk -F' \\| ' 'NR>1 {print $1}' survey-log.txt | sort -u | while read c; do /usr/bin/grep -q ",$c\$" sites.csv && echo "$c found" || echo "$c MISSING"; done
commands_executed: /usr/bin/awk -F' \\| ' 'NR>1 { if (NF!=3 || $1 !~ /^[A-Z]{4}$/ || $2 !~ /^[a-z-]+$/ || $3 !~ /^[1-9][0-9]*$/) print "BAD: " $0; else print "OK: " $0 }' survey-log.txt; echo "---codes---"; /usr/bin/awk -F' \\| ' 'NR>1 {print $1}' survey-log.txt | sort -u | while read c; do /usr/bin/grep -q ",$c\$" sites.csv && echo "$c found" || echo "$c MISSING"; done
hooks: live (user settings source; not suppressible without also dropping the contract)
